summary: Altria Group filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026 disclosing that, effective October 7, 2026, it entered a 2026 Extension Agreement amending its $3.0 billion senior unsecured 5-year revolving credit agreement originally dated October 24, 2023, with JPMorgan Chase and Citibank as administrative agents and the named lenders. The amendment extends the facility's expiration from October 24, 2029 to October 24, 2030; all other terms remain unchanged. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural special-situations mechanics are stated. This is a routine credit-facility extension, not a special situation; watch only for future draws or covenant changes.
